name: The Vessel's Mystery
content: A man's voice lives in the violin case: languid, elegant, sharp-tongued. He speaks; he draws a note only certain ears can hear; he knows more than Eliane does. Yet he never gives his true name, nor says how or why he became a violin. His kindness to Eliane always carries a line that cuts her self-deception — 'You only ever had yourself.'
truth: Left open. Whether he is a sealed man, a friend Eliane has forgotten, or something with his own designs is kept as a long-game hook; the higher qin_trust climbs, the more he is willing to let slip.
